# SellerLedger

> Free audit of your seller contact file, then Amazon and ecommerce seller lists by marketplace, category and revenue band, with 25 matched sample records free.

Free offer: drop a CSV or Excel seller contact file and its contact coverage is graded free in the browser. A coverage plan and 25 matched sample seller records go to a work email.

## Key pages

- [Home and free verification](https://sellerledger.deep-ae0.workers.dev/): drop a list, get a report, verify 1,000 contacts free
- [Home as markdown](https://sellerledger.deep-ae0.workers.dev/index.md)
